notes: Printed: '[-8]: Until end of turn, each Vampire you control gains "{T}: Gain control of target creature."' The -8 has no target: the granted ability's is its own, chosen when a Vampire activates it. Through the act window, as a dealt game asks it, the -8 is one menu row and asks nothing more (a target ask would find no word and fail the pack); Sorin goes to 0 loyalty and is put into the graveyard (CR 704.5i). Before 2026-11-12 the activation walked into the granted ability, asked a target creature for the -8 itself, and the grant then went to that creature instead of each Vampire you control (test_executor_trigger_timing.py checks the grant).
